So, back in the day in 1890, ice Cream sundaes were invented when it became illegal to sell ice-cream sodas on a Sunday in the American town of Evanston, Illinois. As sales of the dessert continued on Mondays, local Methodist leaders then objected to naming the dish after the Sabbath, so the spelling of the name was changed to sundae with an "e".
